Camada com a localização dos barramentos das Pequenas Centrais Hidrelétricas no Brasil. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Pequenas Centrais Hidrelétricas, Hidrelétricas, Empreendimentos hidrelétricos, Energia hidrelétrica, PCH. The portal shows 2023-04-05 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
